title: Kimi Code
intro: Kimi Code, headless over `kimi -p --output-format stream-json`, on an Anthropic- or OpenAI-chat-shaped provider through the `KIMI_MODEL_*` variables.
notes: Installed from the GitHub release archive.
`-c` continues the last session for this directory.
`KIMI_MODEL_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` with a base without `/v1`; `openai` with a `/v1` base for chat completions.
